scripts.dev: npm run build -w @coop/shared && concurrently -n shared,server,client -c yellow,green,cyan "npm run dev -w @coop/shared" "npm run dev -w @coop/server" "npm run dev -w @coop/client"
scripts.dev:server: npm run build -w @coop/shared && npm run dev -w @coop/server
scripts.build: npm run build -w @coop/shared && npm run build -w @coop/server && npm run build -w @coop/client
scripts.start:server: npm run build -w @coop/shared && npm run build -w @coop/server && npm run start -w @coop/server
